title: Southern Grace | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched on a prime corner lot overlooking a serene fountain pond and bordered by the lush Point Washington State Forest, this elegant retreat offers the perfect blend of tranquility and convenience. Just one and a half miles from Seaside’s vibrant dining, shopping, and cultural attractions, this 2,500 sq. ft. home invites guests to immerse themselves in the charm of Florida’s 30A region. Thoughtfully designed for families or groups, the home features four spacious bedrooms, three and a half baths, and luxurious touches like premium mattresses, wall-mounted TVs, and a master suite with a private balcony and outdoor bath setup. Every corner is a testament to refined comfort, from the hardwood floors to the fully equipped kitchen with GE stainless appliances. A wealth of modern amenities ensures relaxation and entertainment for all ages. The private saltwater pool and fire pit offer serene evenings under the stars, while two screened-in porches provide peaceful views of the surrounding forest. Guests have access to Naturewalk’s exclusive “Gathering Place,” complete with a lagoon-style pool, hot tub, pickleball courts, and more. Adventure awaits with included adult bikes, nearby nature trails, and the pristine Scenic 395 Beach Access. With its proximity to local conveniences like Publix and easy access to Destin-Fort Walton Beach Airport, this home is perfectly suited for multi-generational families seeking a luxurious, memory-filled getaway in the heart of the Emerald Coast.
